description: Guided opt-out fer Clustal. A sailor follows the steps on the checklist; OpenOptOut hands over a one-time email address an' clicks any confirmation link.
instructions: Search clustal.org fer {full_name}, open "view full record", an' copy that page's address (the search result's address won't work). Open clustal.org/privacy-control, paste it, smash "remove my info", enter {contact_email} an' smash "remove my info" again. Clustal emails a link to finish; OpenOptOut clicks it fer ye. Then smash "I've done this".
